command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo

if(& git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/definitely-missing-flyexplorer-ref"){
  throw "unexpected existing ref"
}
Write-Host ("AFTER_HANDLED_NONZERO_QMARK={0}" -f $?)
Write-Host ("AFTER_HANDLED_NONZERO_LASTEXIT={0}" -f $LASTEXITCODE)
Write-Host "EXPECTED_MISSING_REF=PASS"
Write-Host ("AFTER_WRITEHOST_QMARK={0}" -f $?)
Write-Host ("AFTER_WRITEHOST_LASTEXIT={0}" -f $LASTEXITCODE)

$handled = 'if(& git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/definitely-missing-flyexplorer-ref"){throw "unexpected"}; Write-Host "INNER_HANDLED=PASS"'
Invoke-Expression $handled
Write-Host ("AFTER_INVOKE_HANDLED_QMARK={0}" -f $?)
Write-Host ("AFTER_INVOKE_HANDLED_LASTEXIT={0}" -f $LASTEXITCODE)

$bare = '& cmd /c exit 7'
Invoke-Expression $bare
Write-Host ("AFTER_INVOKE_BARE_QMARK={0}" -f $?)
Write-Host ("AFTER_INVOKE_BARE_LASTEXIT={0}" -f $LASTEXITCODE)

try {
  Invoke-Expression 'throw "intentional terminating error"'
  throw "terminating error was swallowed"
} catch {
  Write-Host "POWERSHELL_THROW_CAUGHT=PASS"
}
& cmd /c exit 0
Write-Host "POWERSHELL_LASTEXIT_SEMANTICS=PASS"
